finalText:
Written to `INCIDENT-HANDOFF.md`.

Three things in it need your eye before you hand it off:

**ioredis version is unresolved, not answered.** No `package-lock.json`, no `node_modules/` in this directory. I documented the range `^5.4.1` and listed four ways to get the real number, but I did not fill in a version — I don't have one. Doc says so plainly rather than guessing.

**Recovery time is unknown.** Log ends at the `service down` line. Handoff states degraded window (02:14:07 – 02:31:52, 17m45s) and hard-down start, but total impact is open until someone pulls logs past 02:31.

**Date discrepancy flagged at top.** Log is 2026-07-04, you said last night. Doc leads with that so nobody acts on the wrong incident.

Root cause and impact window sections are solid — both come straight from log lines.
